boundary_definitions.total_oob_coords: sum of out-of-bounds coordinates across trials [count]
boundary_definitions.mean_repair_L2: mean L2 of repair displacement over repaired trials [objective units]
boundary_definitions.max_repair_L2: max L2 of repair displacement [objective units]
boundary_definitions.mean_repair_cosine: mean cosine between search direction and repair displacement [-1,1]
boundary_definitions.n_archive_r2: trials where r2 came from archive [count]
boundary_definitions.n_pop_r2: trials where r2 came from population [count]
boundary_definitions.total_improvement: sum of |parent_fit - trial_fit| for successes [objective units]
boundary_definitions.repair_success_rate: success rate among repaired trials [0,1] or -1 if none
boundary_definitions.no_repair_success_rate: success rate among non-repaired trials [0,1] or -1 if none
